items.claim: Paint actions spread an `'inherit'` fill or stroke as an object, writing junk keys
`setStrokeWidth` writes a NaN, infinite or negative width
`setVertexColor` splices an `rgba` of the wrong length or with non-finite channels
Paint actions and nudge act on page structure
items.note: The paint actions really did paint a selected page and stayed enabled with only a page selected. Nudge already moved no page, because `moveNodesOps` drops pages through `translateTargets`. Only its gate was off: it said `NotApplicable` where `SelectionRequired` was meant. That is fixed in the same commit.

items.claim: Paint actions stay enabled when a run would change nothing (A+B, the two reports' `setVertexColor` findings are one)
items.note: for `setVertexColor`, which is now `NotApplicable` while no selected node has `vertexColors`. For the other paint actions I made a call and recorded it in `docs/unruled.md`. These actions are ongoing, and their params usually arrive with the drag's moves. If `enabled` judged the binding's params, a color-picker drag that starts on the current color would be refused before its first move. So they stay enabled, and a run that changes nothing still records no undo entry.

items.claim: Group builds its container from a member's stored, parent-relative pose instead of its world pose, in the no-bounds fallback and the `fromBounds` template
`paintUnchanged.test.ts` passed the opacity actions an `opacity` param they never read
